slots.jd.family-practice.about: Maplewood Family Practice is a private, owner-run family practice in Dayton, Ohio. We care for patients of all ages, and many of them have been with us for years. We are looking for a clinical assistant to join our small team on site. You will help our providers keep the day running smoothly and make sure every patient feels looked after.
slots.jd.family-practice.duties:
What the job involves
- Room patients and prepare them for the provider
- Schedule follow-up visits before patients leave and confirm them by phone or message
- Complete insurance forms accurately and send them on time
- Keep exam rooms clean, tidy and stocked
- Update patient charts after each visit
slots.jd.family-practice.needs:
What you need
- 2 or more years of experience as a clinical or medical assistant
- Skill in patient intake, vital signs, EKG testing and injections
- Experience keeping medical records accurate and handling prior authorizations
- Certified Medical Assistant Credential (required)
- Phlebotomy Certificate (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Coordinates appointment scheduling for clinic and lab visits, reducing gaps in the daily schedule by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Rooms patients and completes patient intake, recording the reason for each visit before the provider comes in.
slots.r1.b3: Stocks exam rooms between visits and handles insurance verification ahead of appointments, cutting check-in delays by 35 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Schedules follow-up visits and updates medical records in Epic Systems so each plan of care is documented.
slots.r1.i1: Supports the clinical team at Riverbend Health Network by scheduling follow-up visits and keeping patients informed of the next steps in their care.
slots.r1.i2: Completes insurance forms for patients at Riverbend Health Network, working under supervision to keep coverage details accurate before each visit.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level medical assistant with about 2 years of experience handling patient messaging, appointment scheduling and medical records in a clinic setting. Works alongside a supervising clinician on a defined share of daily tasks and holds the Certified Medical Assistant Credential.
slots.summary.2: Medical assisting professional with about 2 years in clinical support, trained at Lakeshore Career College. Handles patient messaging, appointment scheduling and medical records with a supervisor close by, taking on a small part of the daily workload.
